newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks sink 1.58 pct on clearing day.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks sink 1.58 pct on clearing day.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended 1.58 percent down on Tuesday as sentiment weakened on political and economic uncertainty. Dealers said the index would sink below 1,600 points soon.
"Small investors unloaded holdings on settlement day and there was little support from major players," dealer Shabeer Sikandar said. "The index will slip below 1,600 points soon."
The Karachi 100-share index fell 25.80 points to end at 1,609.61. Losers beat gainers 293 to 34. Hub Power fell 0.85 rupees to 39.25 and Adamjee Insurance 7.50 to 99.
